title: HtmlInputColor
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type color without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputColor.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet accepted as a prop but not forwarded or rendered, because the component emits no child content for the native input. Its value has no effect on the rendered control.

outputs.name: HtmlInputColor
outputs.description: A native input element with type color is rendered, with the remaining props spread as attributes and no wrapper or child content.
